price_note: Authentic Caucasus flavors, inspired by Azerbaijan, in the heart of Silicon Valley, in their own words. Prices are from the menus on their own site
flags: Hours are set to null because two first-party sources disagree. narfood.com lists Mon-Fri 11:30AM-2PM & 5-10PM and Sat-Sun 9AM-3PM & 5-10PM. The site's own Chowbus online-ordering page linked from the site showed 'SUN (Today) 10:00 AM - 09:45 PM' on 2026-09-27, with no midday break. The Chowbus window may be pickup hours only. The prix fixe menu separately says Mon-Fri 11:30AM-2:00PM and Sat-Sun 11:30AM-3:00PM, which is when the prix fixe is served. If Glenn wants the site hours, use: 'Mon-Fri 11:30am-2pm & 5-10pm; Sat-Sun 9am-3pm & 5-10pm'.

Prices come from the 11 menu images on narfood.com (served from /site_images/, typeset and clearly legible). They are undated. Lunch and dinner are priced separately and published as separate menus, so a dish can appear twice at two prices. For example, Nar Plate is $55 at lunch and $65 at dinner, and Lule Kebab is $27 at lunch and $31 at dinner. Items are kept in the meal sections where they appear.

The Chowbus online-ordering page (order_url) shows a different, smaller 'Nar Menu (Online)' at lower prices, and also shows a 'Take a look' tile for 'Olivia Bros Halal Mediterranean'. Examples: Burger $11.99 vs $16 on the lunch menu, Chicken Shawarma Wrap $13.99 vs $19, Fried Calamari $12.99 vs $17, Cheesesteak Sub $15.99+ vs $18. It also lists 'Olivia Triple Burger', Saj Plate and Chicken Lule Plate, which are not on the site menus. These online prices were NOT used. The raw text is in raw_b_narrestaurant_chowbus.txt.

The menus conflict on the tea pot price: the breakfast drinks list 'Tea Pot - $8', but the drinks page lists 'House Tea Pot (serves up to 4 guests) $12' and the tea set page lists 'Teapot (Serves up to 4 Guests) - $12'. Both prices are kept as published. Fries also differ: $8 on the lunch 'Casual bites' list and 'French Fries' $7 on the dinner sides.

Left out as alcohol: the whole WINES menu image, Beers (Heineken, Stella Artois, Corona, Amstel Light), Sangria (Sol de España), the Fruit Wine Cocktails and Fruit Wine Tasting Flight, and the prix fixe option 'pair with any glass of wine +$10'. Also left out: the 'Non-alcoholic beer' lines (Heineken Original, Stella Artois, $10 each), because they are beer-branded. Add them back if wanted.

Items merged by size or flavor, with the lowest price used and label 'from': Pomegranate Juice (glass $7, 16 oz decanter $14) and Bizim Tarla Compote 1L ($15-$17 by flavor). The Three Nations Grill Platter 'Add Ribeye - $30' add-on is noted in its description, not listed as an item.

Obvious typos fixed: 'Satuday' became 'Saturday' in the prix fixe hours, and the stray double spaces were removed. The 'Buratta' spelling on the site's web food list was not used; the menus say 'Burrata'. Dish names are otherwise kept as printed, including (V) vegetarian markers and the spellings Basdırma and Cız Bız.
Not transcribed: the four catering menus ('Family & Party Tray', 'Corporate Lunch Prix Fixe Packages', 'Premium Dinner / Event Package', 'Corporate Catering'), which open as pop-ups on the home page.
Menu footers: a 20% service fee is added for parties of 6 or more, and there is a $25 corkage fee per bottle. The FAQ says the meats are halal. The chef is named on the menus as Chef Teymur Piriyev.
The home page's customer reviews and stats look like template placeholders ('Sarah Johnson', 'Emily Carter' with stock avatar images, '480K+ Customer Reviews'), so none of them were used.

Address: the Instagram bio and site footer both say 286 W El Camino Real, Mountain View, CA 94040, and Chowbus says '286 West El Camino Real'. The site's Uber Eats link has '286-e-el-camino-real' in its URL slug. That is third-party and was ignored.
